semiconductor_relevance: High — Kenmec specializes in automated conveyor systems that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kenmec Mechanical Engineering Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of automated conveyor equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their innovative Bridge Hoist Conveyor systems enhance production efficiency by accommodating various tool magazine sizes and enabling simultaneous transport of multiple magazines.
capabilities: 690 and 490 series Bridge Hoist Conveyor systems
